entities.summary: Victor Ramos is a retired East Timorese boxer. He was one of the first athletes to represent East Timor at the Olympic Games, when he competed at the Men's lightweight Boxing event at the 2000 Summer Olympics in Sydney, though he technically competed as an individual athlete because East Timor was newly independent and had not yet been formally recognized by the International Olympic Committee. He was also the flag bearer for the Independent Olympians at the 2000 Summer Olympics. Ramos was one of the ten East Timorese athletes who received training in Darwin prior to his participation in the Sydney Olympic Games.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Victor Ramos's participation in the 2000 Summer Olympics marked a significant milestone for East Timorese sports and international recognition. His role as flag bearer for Independent Olympians highlighted the country's growing presence on the global stage.
